method: Built-in image_gen, one local-edit generation per intermediate keyframe. Frame 00 and frame 09 reuse the same original PNG for an exact neutral loop seam.

frames.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE full-body PNG animation keyframe, a very precise local edit of the input image. This is a frame of a continuous wave animation. Image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET.
Canvas: preserve the reference canvas 1451x1084, composition and subject scale. True transparent background/alpha, no checkerboard, no solid background, no frame, no labels.
HARD INVARIANTS: Preserve the exact original face, neutral closed-mouth smile, eyes looking directly at camera, hair, blue scarf, headset, round torso, gold gavel badge, blue-and-white Gzhel pattern, book and viewer-left arm, and silver pedestal. Keep their position and size unchanged. No head tilt, no blinking, no mouth animation, no body sway, no camera movement, no relighting. Keep the original book text "Федеральный закон - 127" and pedestal text "РОССИЯ" completely unchanged.
EDIT ONLY THE ARM ON THE VIEWER'S RIGHT, ITS WHITE MITTEN HAND AND THE PEN IT HOLDS. Delete the old right-arm pose when replacing it: exactly two arms total, no ghost arm left behind.
Anatomy: one thick ceramic blue Gzhel sleeve with the same pattern and white cuff; one white rounded mitten (no separate human fingers). Smoothly joined to the same shoulder near pixel (970,510) of original 1451x1084 frame.
Prop continuity: preserve EXACT same blue-and-silver fountain pen as the input. ALWAYS hold it with the rounded blue cap at the TOP and golden writing nib pointing DOWN; do not flip it end for end, remove its cap, change its length or invent another pen. Keep pen firmly in the hand, slight angle matching the hand, no loose/floating items.
The hand center target and trajectory below are approximate pixel anchors relative to the original canvas, and govern this pose. Do not rescale or shift the whole character to achieve them. The entire pen, arm and pedestal must fit uncropped within canvas. Clean transparent cutout edges without cyan/white halos or stray pixels.

Beginning of lifting: hand center approx (1145,580). Raise the original right hand only about 38 pixels. Arm remains mostly extended sideways, elbow just begins bending. Pen blue cap still up and gold nib down.
